entities.name: Mirna Mazić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mirna Mazić is a Croatian female basketball player, currently playing for Olympiacos. At the 2012 Summer Olympics, she competed for the Croatia women's national basketball team in the women's event. She is 6 feet 2 inches (1.88 m) tall.
